lead: Nature's first food, for your immune system. Bovine colostrum is the nutrient-rich 'first milk' packed with immunoglobulins, growth factors and antibodies — 500 mg per capsule (25% IgG) to support immune defence, gut health and a normal inflammatory response.

science.title: Why colostrum is special
science.text: Colostrum is the very first milk a mother produces — a dense package of immunoglobulins (antibodies), growth factors, lactoferrin and proteins designed to kick-start a newborn's immune system and gut. Our bovine colostrum is standardized to 25% IgG, the key antibody, to support your immune defences, the lining of your gut, and a healthy inflammatory response.

format.title: A whole-food immune builder
format.text: Not an isolated extract but the whole first-milk complex — immunoglobulins, growth factors and lactoferrin — concentrated into one easy capsule a day (or more).

absorb.title: Defend the gut, support immunity
absorb.lead: Colostrum's antibodies and growth factors support the gut lining — where much of your immune system lives — and your body's defences.

points.title: Immunoglobulins (IgG)
points.text: Antibodies that support your immune system's first line of defence — standardized to 25% IgG.

points.title: Gut barrier support
points.text: Growth factors and lactoferrin help maintain the gut lining, where the majority of your immune system resides.

points.title: Inflammatory balance
points.text: Colostrum's bioactive proteins support a normal, balanced inflammatory response.

ingredients.title: One whole-food active

facts.other: Other Ingredients: Organic Long Grain White Rice Flour, Medium-Chain Triglycerides (MCT Oil), Silicon Dioxide, L-Leucine, Vegetable Capsule (Cellulose). Contains: Milk (Colostrum).
facts.side_text: 500 mg of bovine colostrum powder standardized to 25% immunoglobulin G (IgG) per capsule, in a vegetable cellulose capsule. Contains milk. Made in the USA — 60 capsules.
facts.warning: Contains milk (dairy) — not suitable if you have a milk allergy. If you are pregnant or nursing, under 18, immunocompromised, or have a medical condition, consult a physician before use.

steps.text: Take 1 capsule daily with water — or up to 2–3 times daily as needed.

steps.title: On an empty stomach
steps.text: Colostrum is best absorbed on an empty stomach, ideally in the morning or before meals.

steps.title: Daily for best results
steps.text: Immune and gut support builds with consistent daily use over a few weeks.

items.a: Colostrum is the first milk a mother produces after birth — extra-rich in antibodies (immunoglobulins), growth factors and proteins that support immunity and gut health. Ours comes from grass-fed cattle, standardized to 25% IgG.
No — colostrum is a dairy product, so it contains milk and isn't suitable for vegans or those with a milk allergy. The capsule itself is vegetable cellulose.
It's mainly taken to support the immune system and gut health, and a healthy inflammatory response — athletes also use it for recovery.
Ideally on an empty stomach, such as first thing in the morning, so the bioactive proteins absorb well. Take it daily for best results.
Anyone with a milk allergy, and those pregnant or nursing, under 18, immunocompromised, or with a medical condition should consult a physician before use.
